# Gyeol

Gyeol is a native Korean/English document skill for agents. It creates business deliverables from verified HTML templates and reference writing/design rules.

Primary entry point:
- SKILL.md

Agent metadata:
- agents/openai.yaml
- .claude-plugin/marketplace.json

Install:
- Generic agents: npx skills add JangHyun-bin/GyeoL -a '*' -g -y
- Claude Code: npx skills add JangHyun-bin/GyeoL -a claude-code -g -y
- Local checkout: git clone https://github.com/JangHyun-bin/GyeoL.git
- Claude Desktop: upload dist/gyeol.zip

Verification:
- python scripts/package_skill.py
- python scripts/tests/test_build.py
- python scripts/build.py --check

Core references:
- CHEATSHEET.md
- references/brand-profile.md
- references/brand.example.md
- references/writing.md
- references/design.md
- references/production.md
- references/roadmap.md

Templates:
- assets/templates/

Onboarding:
- docs/onboarding.md
